provenance_source.kind: previously committed input contract; no artifact bytes read for A4-1P

residual_view.scalar_fit_objective: exact rational squared error on finite binary32 residual values

inventory.selection_key_expansion: no braces, zero-based canonical decimal ids without leading zeros, no terminating newline
inventory.within_cell_order: ascending raw digest bytes, then ascending vector_id
inventory.pool_assignment: even within-cell rank to fit pool; odd within-cell rank to heldout pool
inventory.allocation: reserve two rows per cell, then capacity-proportional largest remainder independently within each pool
inventory.base_quota: two per cell plus floor(7168 * (pool_cell_count-2) / sum_c(pool_cell_count_c-2))
inventory.remainder_order: descending exact integer remainder numerator, then ascending cell_id
inventory.pairing: within heldout cell, consecutive selected ranks without reuse; lower rank stored; odd final rank unused

fitting.scalar_objective: globally minimum empirical one-dimensional L2 SSE on fit rows
fitting.scalar_solver: compiled native Monge/SMAWK, divide-and-conquer, or equivalent dynamic program over the registered exact rational objective
fitting.scalar_arithmetic: canonicalize signed zero to +0.0; every finite normal/subnormal binary32 x_i is exact n_i*2^-149; aggregate equal n_i values with positive integer weights; interval W=sum(w), A=sum(w*n), C=sum(w*n^2), SSE=((W*C-A^2)/W)*2^-298 using arbitrary-precision integers/rationals; no floating surrogate or max(0) repair
fitting.scalar_monge_contract: weighted sorted 1D squared-error interval costs satisfy the exact Monge/quadrangle property and adding a prior DP row preserves total monotonicity; accelerated DP is valid only with exact rational candidate ordering
fitting.scalar_cardinality_semantics: at most K nonempty intervals; on equal exact SSE choose more intervals then recursive earliest predecessors; for K>H_distinct copy the H_distinct solution and report effective_cardinality=H_distinct; selecting an unreachable nominal K is NO_GO_REPRESENTATION
fitting.scalar_tie: canonical reduced nonnegative numerator/positive denominator; exact arbitrary-precision cross multiplication; earliest predecessor only on mathematical equality
fitting.scalar_runtime_certificate: persist canonical exact curves and partitions; exact-rational replay plus nondecreasing predecessor diagnostic for every cardinality; every comparison must resolve exactly; violation=IMPLEMENTATION_INVALID; diagnostics do not replace the exact Monge contract
fitting.scalar_centroid_rounding: exact mean (A/W)*2^-149 rounded directly RNE to binary64 for block start0 and independently directly RNE to binary32 for runtime arms; no intermediate floating conversion
fitting.scalar_random_parity_suite: one PCG64(20260713) stream; t=0..255; input H=1+(t mod 12); values=integers(-8,9); weights=integers(1,6); K=1..min(8,H_distinct)
fitting.allocation_tie: minimum fit SSE, then maximum used states, then lexicographically smaller cardinalities
block_vq_starts: start 0: arbitrary exact means directly RNE-rounded to binary64, Cartesian product in mixed-radix order, plus deterministic farthest-point fill
starts 1..7: deterministic farthest-first from salted minimum SHA-256 fitting vector
fitting.block_vq_start_hash_template: SHA-256({protocol_version}|{dataset_id}|{capacity}|{group_id}|{start_id}|{cell_id}|{vector_id}); no braces/newline; canonical decimal; digest tie by vector_id
fitting.block_vq_synthetic_suite: fresh PCG64(20260713) stream; t=0..63; N=8+(t mod 25); S=2+(t mod 7); coordinates=integers(-8,9,size=(N,2)); dataset_id=synthetic_block_case_{t}; group=0; row i has cell=i mod 4 and vector=i; selection hashes use registered template; start0 uses exact scalar curves K<=S plus arbitrary allocation capacity S
fitting.global_pack: selected-coordinate order; b_j label bits LSB-first; stream bit t maps to byte floor(t/8), bit t mod 8; zero-pad high tail to exact 32/64-byte payload

lookup.valid_entry_arithmetic: promote binary32 q and centroids to binary64; coordinate-0 square then coordinate-1 square; add; narrow once to binary32
lookup.pair_estimate: group-order binary64 accumulation of stored binary32 LUT entries
lookup.global_control: sum_j K_j binary32 scalar entries; each is float64 promoted subtract/square then one binary32 narrowing; 128 scalar lookups

statistics.unit: two-stage IVF cell then heldout row/pair
statistics.within_cell_draw_count: original selected vector or pair count in each sampled cell occurrence
statistics.replicate_scaling: reconstruction raw SSE divided by replicate vector count; pair raw absolute error divided by replicate pair count; same normalization for point estimates
statistics.target_weighting: vector-weighted or pair-weighted frozen heldout inventory with IVF cells as first-stage clusters, not a mean of cell means
statistics.shared_draws: cell matrix across datasets; within-cell indices across arms and rates
statistics.generation_order: cell matrix integers(0,512,size=(10000,512)); GIST then CIFAR; replicate; cell occurrence; integers(0,n,size=n) vectors; integers(0,m,size=m) pairs
statistics.accumulation_order: point: (cell,digest,vector), then group/coordinate; bootstrap: sampled-cell occurrence, draw, group/coordinate; pairs: (cell,pair_rank); sequential binary64
statistics.interval: basic bootstrap with NumPy method=linear quantiles
statistics.multiple_testing: Holm step-down across the 16 registered one-sided linear-contrast hypotheses; ties by hypothesis id

native_numeric_contract.subnormals: x86-64 MXCSR FTZ and DAZ bits cleared and verified
native_numeric_contract.manifest: compiler identity, complete flags, CPU model, exact integer/rational library and version, rounding mode, MXCSR, NumPy version

execution.synthetic_cost_projection: separate precommitted review command excluded from atomic base CPU; same compiled exact-arithmetic library/compiler, all K=1..256 curves, exact allocations, and direct-rational rounding as base; C-order Generator(PCG64(20260713)).standard_normal((8192,128),dtype=float32); dataset_id=synthetic_cost_projection; row i cell=0 vector=i; group h columns=(2h,2h+1); registered selection/capacity hashes; record NumPy version; all rates/eight starts; projected two-dataset base CPU=2.5x measured
